title: Coherence and entanglement dynamics in Shor's algorithm
summary: Shor's algorithm outperforms its classical counterpart in efficient prime factorization. We explore the coherence and entanglement dynamics of the evolved states within Shor's algorithm, showing that the coherence in each step relies on the dimension of register or the order, and discuss the relations between geometric coherence and geometric entanglement.
